main_measure.name: mean of (5-bar forward return minus coin mean 5-bar return) x forecast/10 on grid bars with forecast < 0
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 cases and check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return, shrink bars minus growth bars, inside the regime (must be < 0)

decided_by: Confirmed on every fold, but the main measure points the other way on the check folds (A, D), the years step 7 does not explore: main measure -0.0009326 on the check folds against +0.01705 on every fold.
reading: Situation taken as 20-day return in [-20 %, 0 %), 60-day return below -10 % (the falling profile of the config's veto) and a negative raw log volume ratio, short side, using the recorded regime where a window lacks the price history; 'inside the regime' read as bars whose recorded regime is 'trending', and the coin's mean 5-bar return taken on the same non-overlapping grid over all its windows.
